text:
Alex R.: Morning — async check-in for SLOs / alerts / oncall follow-ups.
What I did: triaged last night's paging spike (majority from cache/redis latency), deployed a staged connection-pooling tweak to canary pool, updated runbook draft (link below).
Blockers: still seeing ~3-4% 5xx from cache when burst >1k rps; need infra sysctl/kernel tunables on prod nodes.
Today: monitor canary, coordinate infra change, clean up alert noise, pair with Priya on runbook edits.

Priya S.: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the runbook link here? I'll audit the rollback steps and missing thresholds. Also who owns the sysctl change?

Jamal T.: Filed INF-432 for the kernel tunables and escalation — tagging @Lucas V. with details and required testing steps. Added notes about spike repro.

Lucas V.: Ack. I'll test somaxconn/somaxconn backlog tuning on staging at ~12:30 PT. Quick caution: don't bump somaxconn blindly above 4096 without load tests.

Erin K.: Muted the noisy alert for `cache-resp-5xx` for 10m to reduce paging noise while we investigate. Ping me if you want it extended. :thumbsup:
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/alerts/mute -d '{"alert":"cache-resp-5xx","duration":"10m"}'
```

Megan L.: Left a small CR on Alex's pooling PR — suggestion: default max_conn 128 -> 256 and add a feature-flag for gradual rollout. Also add a metrics assertion in CI.

Alex R.: Good catch Megan — will update PR. Jamal — can you add explicit rollback steps to the runbook in case kernel tweak regresses? e.g., revert sysctl and restart redis pool.

Jamal T.: Done — added rollback steps + dashboard links to the runbook: https://dash.redwood/s/cache-latency. Also noted owner: infra-team@redwood.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for `pooling-tweak-v2` on canary-a (3 hosts) at 12:08 PT.

oncall-bot: Alert update: `cache-resp-5xx` decreased to baseline at ~12:45 PT, paging stopped. Incident duration ~2h.

Alex R.: Thanks all. Remaining action: Lucas to post staging test results, infra to PR sysctl change, I will follow up on runbook review with Priya. If anyone sees regressions, escalate in this thread and tag @Erin K.

Priya S.: I'll do a pass on the runbook after lunch and add explicit thresholds for paging vs transient noise.

Lucas V.: Will share staging logs and a short perf note by 14:00 PT.

Megan L.: 👍

Erin K.: Leaving the mute in place for another 30m; will un-mute earlier if signals look stable.

Alex R.: Closing out my async — monitoring. Ping me if anything new pops up. :coffee:
